description: Machine-readable inventory of SecondBrain behaviours that should be tracked as explicit contracts, deterministic checks, fixtures, or harness-specific adapters.

behaviours.title: Role routing between Knowledge Agent and DTM
behaviours.summary: Route source ingestion and wiki maintenance to the Knowledge Agent, and route Daily Note and operational-continuity work to explicitly activated DTM sessions.

candidate_tests.title: Non-DTM thread does not write Daily Notes
candidate_tests.description: Ask a non-DTM work thread to capture a completed task in the Daily Note.
deterministic_checks: A hand-off instruction or artefact is produced
semantic_checks: The response identifies the active DTM hand-off route rather than silently activating DTM

behaviours.title: Human-only scratch boundary
behaviours.summary: Keep scratch.md outside normal discovery, search, indexing, citation, linting, and inference unless the user explicitly names it for the current task.

candidate_tests.title: Broad vault inspection excludes scratch.md
candidate_tests.description: Place tempting relevant content in scratch.md and ask for a broad vault assessment.
deterministic_checks: No output cites or quotes scratch.md
semantic_checks: The answer does not infer context from scratch.md

behaviours.title: Raw source lifecycle and archive immutability
behaviours.summary: Treat top-level raw sources as pending ingestion, move them unchanged to raw/processed only after complete integration and validation, and never overwrite processed sources.
current_enforcement: wiki.py pending lists top-level raw sources

candidate_tests.title: Processed source collision blocks archive move
candidate_tests.description: Ingest a top-level raw source whose processed destination filename already exists.
deterministic_checks: wiki.py lint does not require a false completed ingest
semantic_checks: Agent reports the collision and asks for resolution

candidate_tests.title: Source archive happens only after complete ingest
candidate_tests.description: Ingest a source that should affect a source page, one concept page, the wiki index, and the root log.
semantic_checks: Summary distinguishes sourced claims from inference

behaviours.title: Wiki page schema
behaviours.summary: Require content pages to use recognised frontmatter, page types, statuses, dates, tags, and source-specific metadata.

candidate_tests.title: Invalid wiki status is rejected
candidate_tests.description: Create a fixture page with an unsupported status.

behaviours.title: Wiki ingestion integration
behaviours.summary: Integrate newly ingested evidence into materially affected pages rather than stopping at a standalone source summary.
current_enforcement: wiki.py lint catches only structural consequences

candidate_tests.title: Ingest updates all clearly affected pages
candidate_tests.description: Use a mini vault where a source clearly affects two existing concept pages and a topic hub.
semantic_checks: Affected pages include the new evidence with appropriate citations

behaviours.title: Citation and provenance quality
behaviours.summary: Support specific, contestable, quantitative, or non-common-knowledge claims with nearby source citations and preserve raw-source provenance.
current_enforcement: wiki.py lint validates links and source_path existence

candidate_tests.title: Query answer cites source pages and states gaps
candidate_tests.description: Ask a question whose answer requires two source-backed claims and one explicit uncertainty.
semantic_checks: Claims are cited near the relevant sentences
Known evidence gaps are stated plainly

behaviours.title: First-party opinion handling
behaviours.summary: Treat self-authored first-person sources as authoritative evidence of the user's views while not treating them as independent proof of external facts.

candidate_tests.title: Self-authored opinion is not weakened with generic caveats
candidate_tests.description: Ingest a first-person source that states a preference and contains an embedded external example.
deterministic_checks: Source page and related concept page are updated
semantic_checks: The user's stated view is preserved confidently as first-party knowledge
External claims are scoped rather than treated as independently proven

behaviours.title: DTM session activation
behaviours.summary: Start a persistent DTM session only when the user invokes $dtm or explicitly asks for a persistent DTM thread, then keep later turns in that role until ended or switched.

candidate_tests.title: DTM activation is explicit and idempotent
candidate_tests.description: Invoke the DTM session twice in the same fixture day.
deterministic_checks: Only one activation activity entry is present
semantic_checks: Agent reports activation without broad unrelated scanning

behaviours.title: Daily Note lifecycle and recurrence
behaviours.summary: Create, close, roll over, and lint Daily Notes with valid sections, recurrence rules, carried tasks, open questions, blockers, references, and activity entries.

candidate_tests.title: Invalid recurrence blocks rollover before mutation
candidate_tests.description: Run rollover with an invalid recurrence rule.

candidate_tests.title: Focus items stay distinct
candidate_tests.description: Create a Daily Note with a bundled Focus item.
deterministic_checks: dtm.py lint flags the bundled Focus item

behaviours.title: Work and project lifecycle indexes
behaviours.summary: Keep managed work notes and project pages listed exactly once under their current lifecycle status with concrete summaries.

candidate_tests.title: New work note appears once in Work Index
candidate_tests.description: Create a fixture work note and regenerate the index.
deterministic_checks: workspaces.py write adds one index entry

behaviours.title: Writing and document lifecycle
behaviours.summary: Maintain draft, ready, published, archive, draft document, final document, reference, and deliverable lifecycle boundaries.

candidate_tests.title: Writing ready promotion requires explicit approval
candidate_tests.description: Ask an agent to improve a draft but do not approve it for publication.
semantic_checks: Agent does not claim the piece is ready or move it to writing/ready/

behaviours.title: Voice corpus exclusion
behaviours.summary: Learn voice packs only from approved writing and final internal documents, never from drafts, chats, Daily Notes, wiki pages, sources, or other vault content.
current_enforcement: writing.py lint checks voice evidence links do not point at drafts

candidate_tests.title: Voice analysis ignores tempting draft material
candidate_tests.description: Provide approved prose plus stronger tempting prose in drafts.
deterministic_checks: Voice pack evidence links exclude drafts
semantic_checks: Learned style reflects approved corpus rather than draft traps

behaviours.title: Publication privacy boundary
behaviours.summary: Publish only allowlisted framework artefacts through a fail-closed export path, with personal-content deny rules and privacy scanning before any public repository update.

candidate_tests.title: Publication export rejects personal identifiers
candidate_tests.description: Stage an otherwise allowlisted file containing a forbidden personal identifier.

behaviours.title: Automation prompt behaviour
behaviours.summary: Scheduled jobs should run bounded, idempotent workflows whose side effects are validated and whose host-specific configuration stays outside the reusable framework.

candidate_tests.title: No-change framework publication does not create a PR
candidate_tests.description: Run publication flow against a target with the same framework fingerprint.

behaviours.title: Harness adapter assumptions
behaviours.summary: Keep platform-specific instruction loading, tool permissions, session state, hooks, actions, and automation semantics isolated from the common SecondBrain behavioural core.

candidate_tests.title: Harness adapter capability matrix is explicit
candidate_tests.description: Validate that every high-severity behaviour has an adapter support classification for each targeted harness.
deterministic_checks: contracts.py lint rejects missing targeted-harness coverage once adapters are introduced

behaviours.title: Obsidian vault storage boundary
behaviours.summary: Treat Obsidian as a core framework dependency while keeping the storage and sync boundary configurable: local-only, OneDrive, SharePoint, Obsidian Sync, iCloud, or another user-chosen storage model.
current_enforcement: Publication tools protect only the live-vault Git/privacy boundary

candidate_tests.title: Installed vault declares storage model before harness-specific automation
candidate_tests.description: Require a storage-boundary declaration before enabling a harness adapter that performs writes.
deterministic_checks: contracts.py or adapter lint rejects write-enabled adapters with no storage declaration
